answer: Noise tokens injected at dawn from each block hash: miners must spend 1/64 of rewards on nonce grinding to separate signal from noise. Quartz-hard randomness means a farm's identities can't precompute token paths, so each fake node burns real hashpower. The harbor of honest mining floods sybils with unpredictable cost. A 50-node farm pays 50× grinding energy; break-even hits at 12 identities.
